nodes.description: Address of the sorted token0 of the Uniswap pair tracked by the oracle.
Address of the sorted token1 of the Uniswap pair tracked by the oracle.
IUniswapV2Pair instance whose cumulative prices are observed. External contract target.
Timestamp of the last oracle update, used for timeElapsed computation.
Last observed cumulative price of token0, basis of the average price computation.
Last observed cumulative price of token1, basis of the average price computation.
Fixed point average price of token0 over the last epoch.
Fixed point average price of token1 over the last epoch.
Epoch length in seconds; controls oracle update cadence.
Epoch start timestamp; used by checkStartTime and nextEpochPoint.
Current epoch counter, incremented by the checkEpoch modifier.
Cached next allowed epoch timestamp.
Ownable owner address, guards privileged functions.
Operator address, guards operator-only functions such as setPeriod.
Deploys the oracle: derives the pair via CREATE2, reads tokens, cumulative prices and reserves, stores them in state.
External checkEpoch-gated update; fetches cumulative prices, computes averages and rewrites oracle state.
View function returning the amount out using the stored average price for the given token.
Pure helper exposing UniswapV2Library.pairFor for CREATE2 pair address computation.
Modifier gating execution on block.timestamp >= nextEpochPoint() and mutating epoch/nextTime afterwards.
Operator-only setter for the epoch period.
Owner-only setter for the start time, validated against current block timestamp.
Modifier requiring msg.sender to equal the stored operator address.
Modifier requiring msg.sender to equal the stored owner address.
Owner-only transfer of the operator role.
Owner-only transfer of contract ownership.
Computes the next epoch boundary from startTime, epoch, period and cached nextTime.
Caller-controlled address used by onlyOwner and onlyOperator authorization checks.
Miner-influenceable timestamp driving epoch gating, nextTime and start time validation.
External call into the pair contract (price0CumulativeLast, price1CumulativeLast, getReserves) performed before state updates inside update().
Unchecked cumulative price subtraction and division by timeElapsed producing the average price.
Access/eligibility decision based purely on block.timestamp comparisons in checkEpoch and checkStartTime.
Oracle state (averages, cumulative prices, timestamp) written after external calls, potential reentrancy window.
constructor parameter: factory address used for CREATE2 pair derivation.
constructor parameter: first token of the tracked pair.
constructor parameter: second token of the tracked pair.
constructor parameter: epoch period passed to Epoch.
constructor parameter: epoch start time passed to Epoch.
local IUniswapV2Pair obtained from UniswapV2Library.pairFor in the constructor.
local reserve0 read from pair.getReserves() in the constructor.
local reserve1 read from pair.getReserves() in the constructor.
local cumulative price of token0 returned by currentCumulativePrices in update().
local cumulative price of token1 returned by currentCumulativePrices in update().
local truncated block timestamp returned by currentCumulativePrices in update().
local elapsed seconds used as divisor for the average price in update().
consult parameter: token address used to select price0Average or price1Average.
consult parameter: input amount converted with the stored average price.
transferOwnership parameter: new owner address.
transferOperator parameter: new operator address.
setPeriod parameter: new epoch period value.
setStarttime parameter: new epoch start timestamp.

constructor writes token1 taken from the pair.

update() reads and rewrites price1CumulativeLast as the new baseline.

update() writes the recomputed token1 average price.

onlyOperator authorizes based on msg.sender equality with _operator.
onlyOwner authorizes based on msg.sender equality with _owner.

setStarttime is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.

transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
block.timestamp is the sole input of the epoch gating logic.
checkEpoch allows execution solely based on a block.timestamp comparison.
setStarttime accepts or rejects values based on the current block timestamp.
now >= nextEpochPoint() decides whether the caller may run update().
checkEpoch consults nextEpochPoint() to decide whether to proceed.
nextEpochPoint() reads startTime for the boundary calculation.
nextEpochPoint() reads the current epoch counter.
nextEpochPoint() reads the epoch period.
nextEpochPoint() returns the cached nextTime when it is larger.
checkEpoch wraps update() and gates it on epoch timing.
checkEpoch reads period to compute the next epoch timestamp.
checkEpoch increments the epoch counter after execution.
checkEpoch recomputes and stores nextTime after execution.
update() performs external calls to the pair via currentCumulativePrices before writing state.

price1Average is written in the post-external-call state update block.
price0CumulativeLast is refreshed after the external call.
price1CumulativeLast is refreshed after the external call.
blockTimestampLast is refreshed after the external call.

local price0Cumulative feeds the average price arithmetic.
local price1Cumulative feeds the average price arithmetic.
